edition.title: This weekend on Keowee + Jocassee
edition.dek: Free jazz in the alley Thursday, an Eagles tribute band takes over Walhalla for three nights straight, a 5K for a good cause Saturday morning — and a slow sunset run out onto Jocassee to close it out.

events.title: Jazz on the Alley
events.body: Seneca's Thursday-night institution — free live jazz on historic Ram Cat Alley, every week through October. The happy-hour set starts at 5:30, the main act at 6:30. Get dinner downtown and let the weekend start a day early.
events.note: Free · 6:30–9pm (happy hour 5:30) · Ram Cat Alley, downtown Seneca

events.title: 7 Bridges — The Ultimate Eagles Experience
events.body: An Eagles tribute band takes over the old Walhalla auditorium for three nights running — no backing tracks, just Hotel California, Take It Easy, and the rest of the catalog played straight. Same show each night, so pick whichever fits your weekend.

events.title: Live music at both lake breweries
events.body: Keowee Brewing in Seneca and Jocassee Valley Brewing in Salem both run free live music Friday and Saturday nights, with food trucks at Jocassee Valley. Neither calendar had this week's acts posted as of publish — check the links before you head out.
events.note: Free · Fri & Sat · check each calendar for this week's lineup and set times

events.title: Buggy Bee 5K
events.body: The inaugural Buggy Bee 5K, walk, and virtual race benefits First Light, honoring the legacy behind the Gwynnie Bee House. The course starts at Shaver Recreation Complex, with food trucks and sponsor booths after.
events.note: $40 · 8am start · Shaver Recreation Complex, Seneca · registration closes Aug 20

events.title: Sunset Lake Tour
events.body: A slower two-hour run out onto Jocassee as the light goes gold over the mountains, with a waterfall or two along the way. Runs every Saturday evening through the season.
events.note: $65 · 2 hours · every Saturday · Jocassee Lake Tours

plan.title: An Eagles tribute, three nights running
plan.body: 7 Bridges plays the WPAC stage all three nights this weekend — same band, same set. Pick whichever night works, then spend the day on the water before you go.
plan.label: Grab tickets ↗

plan.title: Run it off, then float it off
plan.body: The Buggy Bee 5K kicks off at 8am for a good cause, then it's Devils Fork or a lake ramp before the afternoon fills in.
plan.label: Find a ramp →

plan.title: Keep it slow before the drive home
plan.body: No headline event Sunday — pick a swim beach, check today's lake level, or grab a table on the water before you head out.
plan.label: Pick a swim spot →
